DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA cor. Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilg_gov.ph OILG OPINION NO. S. HON. CHARLOTTE D. PANAL Mayor, Municipality of Tambulig Province of Zamboanga del Sur Dear Mayor Panal: This refers to your letter dated July 20, 2023 requesting the Department's opinion on whether the appropriation for the Maintenance and Other Operating Expenses (MOOE) in the Office of the Sangguniang Bayan can be used for grants and donations to barangays. Our view is in the negative. Section 336 of the Local Government Code of 1991 (LGC) is enlightening, thus: Section 336. Use of Appropriated Funds and Savings. - Funds shall be available exclusively for the specific purpose for which they have been appropriated. No ordinance shall be passed authorizing any transfer of appropriations from one item to another. However, the local chief executive or the presiding officer of the sanggunian concerned may, by ordinance, be authorized to augment any item in the approved annual budget for their respective offices from savings in other items within the same expense class of their respective appropriations. (Emphasis ours) The local chief executive may be authorized to realign/transfer funds, provided that the following requisites must concur: I. There must be an ordinance authorizing the Local Chief Executive or the Presiding Officer to augment any item; 2. The item to be augmented is limited to their respective offices; and 3. The funds from where the "augmentation" should come from the savings in the other items within the same expense class of each office's respective appropriationsl. On a note, please be informed that realignment/transfer of funds pertains to the authority of the Local Chief Executive or the Presiding Officer of the sanggunian pursuant to an ordinance to augment any item in the approved annual budget. 1 DILG Opinion No. 28, series 2020 dated February 4, 2020 "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

This opinion shall be without prejudice to any contrary opinion rendered by more competent authorities and/or the courts. We hope to have addressed your concern sufficiently. Thank you.
